questions.explanation: Three retrograde plus four anterograde periods gives seven affected periods total. Both directions of amnesia are present.

questions.learningObjective: Explain why self-testing beats rereading

stimulus.body: Astronomer Nia self-tests versus rereads star names; self-testing yields better recall after a week.

questions.stem: What mechanism explains Nia's better recall from self-testing?
questions.explanation: Active retrieval during self-testing strengthens memory more than passive rereading. This is the testing effect.
